$comment: Generated from the Buildish Release Tooling Pydantic models. Do not edit by hand; regenerate with `make schemas`.
description: Action manifest emitted after publishing and signing final RC vote materials. This command manifest is internal Buildish workflow I/O and is not a supported external API.

action.description: Stable command action identifier written by one Buildish command manifest.
action.title: Action

authoritative_manifest_sha512.description: SHA-512 digest of the authoritative staged RC vote manifest.
authoritative_manifest_sha512.title: Authoritative Manifest Sha512

authoritative_manifest_url.description: Canonical staged URL of the signed RC vote manifest.
authoritative_manifest_url.title: Authoritative Manifest Url

bootstrap_script_sha512.description: SHA-512 digest of the emitted verify-rc bootstrap script.
bootstrap_script_sha512.title: Bootstrap Script Sha512

bootstrap_script_url.description: Staged URL of the emitted verify-rc bootstrap helper script.
bootstrap_script_url.title: Bootstrap Script Url

component.description: Component identifier for the Buildish command manifest or emitted action record.
component.title: Component

draft_release_url.description: GitHub draft release URL associated with the current RC or final release workflow.
draft_release_url.title: Draft Release Url

final_tag.description: Final immutable Git tag that Buildish intends to publish for the released version.
final_tag.title: Final Tag

gpg_fingerprint.description: OpenPGP fingerprint of the signing key Buildish used or verified.
gpg_fingerprint.title: Gpg Fingerprint

mirrored_asset_names.description: GitHub release asset names that Buildish mirrored from the staged vote materials into the draft release bundle.
mirrored_asset_names.title: Mirrored Asset Names

rc_tag.description: Exact RC Git tag, including the leading `v` prefix and `-rcN` suffix.
rc_tag.title: Rc Tag

rc_tag_target_commit.description: Git commit SHA that the RC tag resolved to during verification or publication.
rc_tag_target_commit.title: Rc Tag Target Commit

resolved_source_ref.description: Resolved source Git commit SHA that Buildish selected for release production or verification.
resolved_source_ref.title: Resolved Source Ref

secondary_artifact_count.description: Count of secondary artifacts associated with the related manifest or publication step.
secondary_artifact_count.title: Secondary Artifact Count

source_artifact_url.description: Canonical staged download URL of the source release artifact referenced by the RC vote materials.
source_artifact_url.title: Source Artifact Url

version.description: Release version string without a leading `v` prefix.
version.title: Version
